tier_rule: rk: the wallet's CLV tier now (scripts/pm_clv_tiers.py, NBA and NFL only): sharp, mid, dull or thin. Price skill, not a record.
proven_rule: sport book n >= 6, win rate >= 55%, dollar ROI > 3%, not excluded (hedger, churn)
note: Who holds what, as of the last holders scan. Money is shares x market price, not what the wallet paid. No entry price is stored. Context only: never a pick, a size or an agree total.
v2_fields: per wallet: flat_roi fwd first_seen last_settled n30_games usual_med sc_sport sc_n name_disp name_src exp_w luck_p v2 (rk.post rk.sd); per position: side_usd side_rungs side_press px_age_min; top level: since_from since_file retained. fwd = rows with src forward, settled at or after the wallet's first_seen (a bet may have been placed before it); first_seen = the earliest date for the wallet in first_seen.json and follow_only.json. since_file names the file with each wallet's dated settled list (docs/sharps-v2-accounts-spec.md K). All stored fields or arithmetic on them; null when not computable.
